comment: The shift multiplies the bin numbers of the spectrum, PShift.cpp:48-56, so it is a frequency ratio rather than an interval in semitones; the knob is not marked in either. The transform is 4096 samples long with a quarter hop, PShift.cpp:5, and the phases are reset when a sharp rise in level is detected, PShift.cpp:34, which keeps transients from smearing further. This is taken from the pitch shift example of the Gamma library.
